background: Bank of China (UK) Limited is the UK-incorporated subsidiary of Bank of China, one of China's four large state-owned commercial banks, serving Chinese corporates, trade finance and the Chinese community in Britain.
synthesis: None of Fitch, S&P or Moody's publishes a rating on the UK subsidiary, so any comfort comes from the state-owned parent rather than from the entity itself. No capital or liquidity figures are held on this site for it either, which leaves no peer comparison to make. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. For a depositor this is a parental-support name: the question is how far Bank of China would stand behind its London subsidiary, and there is no public rating here to lean on.
